title: A worked implementation
body: I prefer a concrete implementation with a small runnable example and explicit tradeoffs.

title: A broad introduction
body: I prefer a short overview that explains the vocabulary before going into implementation.

title: An experimental result
body: I prefer controlled experiments with measurements, confidence intervals, and limitations.

title: A visual explanation
body: I prefer an illustrated explanation that makes an unfamiliar mechanism easy to picture.

title: A contrary perspective
body: I prefer a reasoned counterargument that could change the direction of my project.

title: A practical checklist
body: I prefer a concise sequence of actions I can try in my project today.

title: A deep derivation
body: I prefer a mathematical derivation that explains why the method behaves as it does.

title: An inspiring case study
body: I prefer a concrete story about a builder's choices and the product they created.
